title: Restart-tour control clears completion state and re-opens the tour
asA: returning principal who completed the tour but wants to see it again
iWant: a restart-tour control on the settings surface that clears my completion state and re-opens the tour
soThat: I can revisit the guidance without clearing local storage by hand or hunting through the surface for a hidden trigger

acceptanceCriteria.description: The restart-tour control renders on the settings surface as a <button data-action="restart-tour"> reachable via Tab and activatable with Enter; activating it clears the completion state in the applied store (per ADR-2702) and re-opens the tour on the highest-value surface on the next principal load. Covered as part of AC-26104-1's pack check (the check exercises the restart flow end-to-end).

When the restart-tour control fires but the completion store rejects the clear, the tour does not open and the console log carries data-error=COMPLETION_CLEAR_FAILED with a retry control; the control stays keyboard-reachable.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the completion store rejects the clear
acceptanceCriteria.then: the tour does not open, data-error=COMPLETION_CLEAR_FAILED is logged and a retry control renders keyboard-reachable
